name: Nested P/C/O/M/H forecast comparison, phase-wise scores and corrected leave-one-protocol-out
context: Post hoc robustness analysis on roles that have already been inspected (pilot, pre-registered expansion and the B3 reference comparison); it is not a new confirmation.
Data roles, forecast origins (fixed 10-min observed warmup), future-command information and scores are those of configs/fgf2_expanded_protocol.json.

B3 posterior: fitted to the means of sus and 3/20 at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml; sp_5 and mixed at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml entered the authors' likelihood-based architecture comparison (config_fgf_sus_3_20.xml). It is used as a calibrated reference and is not refit.

models.C: current input, input squared, current reporter, reporter squared, input x reporter, 2-min slope, known future commands (equals pre-registered local_slope)
models.O: C + causal reporter filters with scales 2, 10, 60 min
models.M: O + matched-feedback B3 increment (posterior samples weighted by the cell's past reporter, scale sigma)
models.H: M + causal input filters with scales 2, 10, 60 min + cumulative exposure (feature set equals M3 of b3_forecast.py)
models.clock_sensitivity: C, O, M and H each refit with time and time squared added; reported as a sensitivity analysis only

selection.sigma_rule: minimize the condition-equal MSE of current reporter + B3 increment on the validation role
selection.alpha_rule: fit on train, minimize the condition-equal validation MSE; standardization inside each fit from its training rows

phases.definition: per forecast row with origin t and horizon h under the recorded half-open pulse schedule
phases.stimulation: the command is on at t
phases.next_command: the command is off at t and a pulse starts in (t, t + h]
phases.early_washout: otherwise, when the last pulse ended at most 30 min before t
phases.scope: pooled over test roles A, B and C with condition-equal weighting inside each phase; per-role counts reported

example.rule: 25 ng/ml is the dose of the readiness study; the cell at position floor(n/2) of the cells sorted by their 10-min H MSE (ties by cell id)

lopo.groups: sus, 3/20, single 5 min, single 10 min, single 60 min, mixed at the new concentrations; the inspected mixed 2.5/250 blocks are excluded
lopo.rule: for each outer held-out group: sigma minimizes the condition-equal MSE of the B3 feedback forecast over all training groups; alpha minimizes the mean condition-equal MSE over inner leave-one-group-out folds of the training groups; refit on all training groups; the held-out group enters no standardization, selection or fit
lopo.b3_disclosure: each fold reports whether its conditions were used by the B3 fit or architecture comparison

comparisons.primary: H versus M, 10-min RMSE on test A (single 10-min pulse, new protocol)
secondary: H versus M per corrected LOPO fold

decision_rule: Input history is reported as an additional predictive contribution only if H has lower 10-min test-A RMSE than M and beats M in at least 4 of the 6 corrected LOPO folds; otherwise the prediction contribution is stated as reporter filtering plus mechanism, and input history as adding no consistent value.
reporting: All comparisons are reported whatever their direction; no significance testing (no independent-day replicates).
